title: Boundary value analysis
scenario: An age field accepts values from 18 to 60. Which inputs should you test?
tip: Bugs hide at the edges. Test the boundary, one step inside and one step outside.

title: Equivalence partitioning
scenario: A password needs 8 to 16 characters. You do not need 20 tests. Pick one value per group.
tip: Split the inputs into groups that behave the same, then test one value from each group.

title: Smoke test vs regression test
scenario: A new build arrives. Run these in order.
cases: if this fails, stop and report
after smoke passes: did anything break?
tip: Smoke asks 'is it alive?'. Regression asks 'did we break something that worked?'

title: A bug report people can fix
scenario: Developers act faster when the report has all five parts.
tip: If a developer has to ask you a question, the report was missing something.

title: Negative testing a login
scenario: Good testers try to break the form on purpose.
tip: Happy path first, then break it. Every rejected input should fail safely.
